gaps.title: Missing Frontend UI for report signature
gaps.jtbd: When I am an Epidemiologist viewing a generated dossier report, I want to sign it, so that the dossier has legal/domain validity.
gaps.acceptanceCriteria: Given an epidemiologist views a dossier report, When they click sign and provide a signature, Then the report status updates to signed.
gaps.reason: The brief explicitly mentions 'Эпидемиолог с правом подписи досье' (Epidemiologist with the right to sign the dossier). The backend has a sign endpoint for dossier reports, but there is no UI mechanism in the frontend to trigger this signature action.
